field.label: Enable
field.help: Manage the WireGuard tunnels listed below. Turning this off stops every behaviour below. Turning this off removes security pins from the firewall.

field.label: Health mirror
field.help: Hold each tunnel down while the WAN it is bound to is down, and each IPv6 tunnel gateway down while its IPv4 tunnel is unhealthy.

field.label: IPv6 addresses and routes
field.help: Keep each tunnel's IPv6 address and the host route to its IPv6 next hop in place (core does not add IPv6 far-gateway routes).

field.label: Default-route guard
field.help: Remove a default route through a tunnel or any other non-default gateway, for both address families.

field.label: WAN pins
field.help: Block each tunnel's handshakes from leaving by any WAN other than the one its endpoint route binds it to. Turning this off removes security pins from the firewall.

field.label: Only NATed traffic into tunnels
field.help: Block any packet that would enter a tunnel from an address that is not one of the firewall's own (i.e. traffic that was not translated by outbound NAT). Turning this off removes security pins from the firewall.

field.label: MSS clamp
field.help: Clamp TCP MSS on each tunnel to its MTU (IPv4 MTU−40, IPv6 MTU−60), both directions.
